Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Record Class CosmeticType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticType
Record Components:
key - the type's key
name - the display name, in Zentrix's colour format
description - the description lines, in Zentrix's colour format; empty for built-in ones, whose description is in the locale file
icon - the icon of its tile in the cosmetics menu; a copy
defaultId - the cosmetic used by players who chose none, or null when there is none
source - the name of the plugin that provides it, Zentrix for built-in ones
available - whether it can be used on this server; Zentrix's gliders and cage designs are not part of the Free edition
public record CosmeticType(@NotNull CosmeticTypeKey key, @NotNull String name, @NotNull List<String> description, @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack icon, @Nullable String defaultId, @NotNull String source, boolean available) extends Record
A kind of cosmetic as the cosmetics menu shows it: one of Zentrix's own categories or one an addon registered. A snapshot.
Since:
1.11.0
